selected_experiences.title: Data Analyst — Weekly Business Reporting
relevance: Recurring SQL workflows and reporting tables across product and customer data directly support the role’s need for reliable analytics datasets and regular reporting.
Validated joins and metric logic, then used Tableau to communicate trends to business stakeholders—evidence for trustworthy reporting and cross-functional communication.

selected_experiences.title: Data Analyst — Reporting Data Quality Controls
relevance: Recurring checks for missing data, duplicates, stale feeds, and inconsistent joins directly address data-quality monitoring across reporting datasets.
Exception-based review surfaced issues before reporting, supporting the job’s emphasis on dependable KPI visibility.

selected_experiences.title: Data Analyst — Promotion Performance Analysis
relevance: SQL and Python analysis of customer behavior across segments and time periods supports product and customer analysis.
Baseline-versus-promotion comparisons and stakeholder summaries provide transferable evidence for measuring and communicating impact, but do not establish experience with controlled experiments.

selected_experiences.title: Simulated Product Metrics Workflow and Dashboard
relevance: The PostgreSQL and Python workflow and Tableau dashboard demonstrate direct practice tracking activation, retention, churn, and cohorts—product metrics not established by the work roles.
Its simulated setting makes it useful supporting evidence for product KPI monitoring, rather than a substitute for production product-analytics experience.

emphasize: Anchor the resume in current SQL-based reporting, Tableau communication, and validation of product and customer metrics.
Show data-quality controls as a distinct contribution to reliable analytics datasets and recurring reports.
Use the simulated project to demonstrate activation and retention KPI familiarity, clearly identifying it as a project.
Present promotion analysis as impact measurement and stakeholder communication, without calling it a controlled experiment.
deemphasize: The operational-data internship overlaps with stronger, more recent evidence of SQL, Python, and reporting-data validation.
Sales and inventory details beyond what is needed to explain the broader product, customer, and operational reporting work.
